phases.intro: Each map starts with how you approach something. Every choice branches into its own line of consequences. Bright lines are the path you played, and dashed boxes are choices nobody has tried yet.

PRO-001.title: Prologue

overview.target: Lucia's intake interview at Hamlet Correctional Facility
overview.objective: Answer Stephanie Gates's questions about how Lucia ended up in prison.

PRO-001.intel: Told as a flashback. Nine months earlier Lucia, at a low point, holds up a coffee shop, escapes once and is then caught. Gates is screening inmates for a supervised release trial, and Lucia lists Jason Duval's address as her intended residence. Playable protagonist: Lucia.

setup.name: First Escape
setup.objective: Push through aggressively and break out clean on the first attempt.

setup.name: Second Escape
setup.objective: Get caught as scripted so Lucia is remanded to prison, which anchors the opening timeline.

notes: Marauder's Chronicle names the prison Leonida Penitentiary, but the in-game call says Hamlet Correctional Facility. Confirm which one is on screen.

GON-002.title: Gone Fishing

overview.target: Donnie, holed up in a trailer
overview.objective: Extract Donnie, drive Cal home, then take Brian's orders at the Key Lento safehouse.

GON-002.intel: Jason's first morning of the chapter. Brian ends it by handing out two chores: collect overdue rent from the Moonstone Boutique acid lab and fix up the house.

setup.name: Stealth Extraction and Trailer Cash
setup.objective: Slip quietly into the trailer to extract Donnie.
setup.intel: Before leaving, sweep the interior and collect all loose cash.

setup.name: Drive Cal Home
setup.objective: Drive Cal back. He asks when Jason is fixing his '70 Ganado.

setup.name: Brian's Two Priorities
setup.objective: At the Key Lento safehouse, Brian stops by and assigns two tasks.
setup.intel: 1) Collect overdue rent from the Moonstone Boutique acid lab. 2) Fix up the house.

notes: Chronicle rule, Stubborn '70 Ganado: Jason refuses to baby his rattling car. Brush off Cal and Joey, and drive cleanly with zero crashes.
Chronicle rule: skip the WAiNK tourist landmark scans in Chapter 1. Save the sightseeing photos for Lucia once she's out.

lore.name: Brian Heder
lore.note: Jason's boss. Texts show him sending Jason to the marina to drive clients and asking him to keep feeding his snake.

lore.name: Cal and Donnie
lore.note: Jason's friends and coworkers. Donnie is the reckless one.

GEA-003.title: Gear Up

overview.objective: Buy a weapon at Ammu-Nation and survive the Kingfisher ambush outside.

GEA-003.intel: Chuck, a fellow ex-Marauder, calls as soon as free roam starts. The Kingfishers then jump Jason in the parking lot.

setup.name: Chuck's Call and Feeding Dolores
setup.objective: Take Chuck's call from Ammu-Nation. Before leaving the house, feed the pet snake, Dolores.

setup.name: Arming the Marauder
setup.objective: Buy the Hawk and Little Mediator tactical rifle at Ammu-Nation.
setup.intel: Its clean 9mm carbine handling suits Jason's Marauder background. Store it in the safehouse gun locker, since Jason isn't taking his car to the shop.

setup.name: Kingfisher Ambush
setup.objective: Outside Ammu-Nation, a group of Kingfishers jumps Jason in the lot.
setup.intel: Neutralize them with fists only, no firearms in broad daylight.

notes: Chronicle rule, Gun Locker Discipline: keep the rifle locked in the gun locker during local Key Lento errands to keep a low profile.
Texts say Dolores is Brian's snake and Jason is looking after her. The Chronicle calls her Jason's pet. Check which.

lore.name: Chuck
lore.note: Ammu-Nation contact. Jason helped him kick a troublemaker out of the shop and Chuck owes him one. He recognizes Jason as ex-Marauders.

lore.name: Kingfishers
lore.note: Local gang. Donnie's texts curse them out and Brian's trouble with them is only starting.

required: Hawk and Little Mediator tactical rifle

JUS-004.title: Just a Scratch
notes: Skipped in the Marauder's Chronicle run. Jason's '70 Ganado stays unrepaired, keeping his hardheaded streak intact until Lucia's prison pickup.

LAB-005.title: Lab Fees

overview.target: Moonstone Boutique acid lab, Key Lento
overview.objective: Collect Brian's overdue rent by clearing out the lab, then stash the product at his lockup.

LAB-005.intel: The lab sits inside Moonstone Boutique, behind the market near the Wonder Whale. Everything in the back room is cleared before leaving.

setup.name: Skip the Tourist Scan
setup.objective: Walk straight past the Wonder Whale sculpture without taking a WAiNK photo (saved for Lucia).

setup.name: Intimidate the Clerk and Find the Notepad
setup.objective: Inside Moonstone Boutique, draw your gun on the lab employee. He panics and bolts before giving the code.
setup.intel: Step behind the counter and flip over the notepad to uncover 0420.

setup.name: Collectible Card
setup.objective: Grab the "Wokester" Standard Card inside the boutique.

setup.name: Breach and Clear
setup.objective: Enter 0420 on the back-room keypad. Collect all acid sheets, smash the black-and-white contrast money box for hidden cash, and crack the wall safe (0420).
setup.intel: Seal the building forever when done.

setup.name: Lockup Drop-Off
setup.objective: Carry the product to Brian's lockup at El Tropical Private Club, enter 7700 and secure the stash.

notes: Codes: lab keypad and wall safe 0420. Brian's lockup strongbox 7700.
Chronicle rule, one-shot loot alert: unmarked high-value containers and stashes inside locking rooms are cleared 100% before exfil.

lore.name: Moonstone Boutique
lore.note: Acid lab front. Brian's texts send Jason to the market behind the Wonder Whale.

UNW-006.title: Unwanted Attention

overview.objective: Steal a red Imponte Phoenix from the impound lot and escape cleanly.

UNW-006.intel: Run as a zero-casualty stealth exfil: no knockouts, no kills.

setup.name: Bypass the Gate
setup.objective: Ride in Cal's truck to the impound. Circle counter-clockwise around the outer wall, ride the back-wall scissor lift onto the roof and drop silently behind cover.

setup.name: Bottle Lure and Pre-Open the Gate
setup.objective: Pick up a glass bottle and toss it (R2 / RT) outside the security booth, or open the trunk of the grey vehicle the mechanic is working on to trigger its alarm and lure the guard away.
setup.intel: Slip into the empty booth and press the red gate button before touching the car.

setup.name: Unhook and Zero-Damage Escape
setup.objective: Pull the tow-hook release lever on the driver's side of the tow truck first so the Phoenix drops cleanly. Hotwire it, drive out the pre-opened gate and lose the scripted 1-star heat within two side turns.
setup.intel: Roll into the Hamlet Pay 'n' Spray. If the Phoenix took no damage, the repair option is marked with a black and white checkmark and needs no repair.

notes: Spoiler: the scripted 1-star heat is lost within two side turns.

PIP-007.title: Pipework
PIP-007.type: Story mission · Day 1 late afternoon · Jason

overview.objective: Collect Brian's rent from Mandy and fix her kitchen sink.

PIP-007.intel: The mission begins with a call from Joey, the mechanic, about the '70 Ganado.

setup.name: Brush Off Joey
setup.objective: When mechanic Joey calls about the '70 Ganado, pick "When I get a minute."

setup.name: Double-Interrupt Mandy
setup.objective: Head to Mandy's house for Brian's rent. Pick Interrupt on the first prompt to demand the plunger, then Interrupt again in the kitchen to shut down her small talk and fix the sink.

setup.name: Missable Cigar Box
setup.objective: Right outside Mandy's front door, walk into her yard and pick up the Macizo Cigar Box she tossed out.

notes: Missable: Macizo Cigar Box in Mandy's yard.

lore.name: Mandy
lore.note: Brian's tenant, listed under Properties in the phone.

lore.name: Joey
lore.note: Mechanic who keeps asking Jason to bring the Ganado in.

HEY-008.title: Hey Arnold!

overview.objective: Track down Brian's missing broker with Cal.

HEY-008.intel: The scripted chase crosses both Key Lento Bridge stunt jumps in story flow, so they complete without touching the '70 Ganado.

setup.name: Track Down Arnold
setup.objective: Take Brian's call. During the high-speed chase, the scripted route sends you across the abandoned Key Lento Bridge East and West Stunt Jump ramps.

setup.name: Sunset Collectible Sweep
setup.objective: On the return leg, grab the "Marquise Bernard" Standard Card off a barrel behind Kenton's shop and pass the Fatal Incursion Plaque (leave the WAiNK scan for Lucia).
setup.intel: Smoke a cigar on the balcony and sleep until Day 3.

notes: Both bridge stunt jumps complete naturally during the chase.

ISL-009.title: Island Dreams

overview.objective: Run Kenton's underwater shipwreck cover dive.

ISL-009.intel: An optional salvage dive follows for clean offshore cash.

setup.name: Kenton's Shipwreck Dive
setup.objective: Head to Kenton's dock on Dolphin Dr. and run the underwater shipwreck cover dive, followed by the optional salvage dive.

setup.name: Islet Silver Card Detour
setup.objective: Out on the water near eastern Key Lento, beach the boat on the small islet east of the Key Lento Pay 'n' Spray to claim the "America's Next Top Hooker" Drake Silver Card beside the tent and deck chair.

notes: Collectible: "America's Next Top Hooker" Drake Silver Card on the islet.

TOU-020.title: Tourist Trap
notes: Reported point of no return for Chapter 1: starting it locks the final three missions and removes access to Jason's house

HOU-023.title: Fixing Brian's House

overview.objective: Complete the house repairs and wind down for the night.

HOU-023.intel: Not a mission, but it carries missables. Prioritize Brian's roof over Jason's car.

setup.name: Safehouse Upkeep
setup.objective: Grab Brian's $600 acid lab cut from the front mailbox, complete every house repair prompt and hang up the punching bag.

setup.name: Read All 5 Safehouse Books
setup.objective: Orca (kitchen sideboard), Lethal by Design (dining table), Body Copy (balcony table), Ashes of Glory (bedroom nightstand), Off the Hook (downstairs workshop).

setup.name: Wind Down
setup.objective: Smoke one of Mandy's Macizo Cigars on the balcony and sleep until Day 2.

SHR-024.title: Get Shirley's Rum

overview.objective: Buy Shirley's rum and deliver it next door.

SHR-024.intel: Delivering the rum starts a 24-hour timer for Part 2, Steal the Scooter.

setup.name: Conditioning and Neighbor Favor
setup.objective: Hit the punching bag and kettlebells, check on Dolores, then walk next door to accept the job from Shirley.

setup.name: Three Sheets Liquor Vent Stash
setup.objective: Buy the rum inside, climb the back-alley fence, talk to the caged parrot and search the white vent next to the yellow generator for $1,000+.
setup.intel: Then deliver the rum to Shirley.

notes: Chronicle rule, one-shot loot alert: take the vent stash.

lore.name: Shirley
lore.note: Jason's elderly neighbor. Her texts complain about noise and her dog Arugula.

SCO-025.title: Steal the Scooter

overview.objective: Swipe Peggy's mobility scooter and deliver it to Shirley.

SCO-025.intel: Available about 24 in-game hours after delivering Shirley's rum. The reward is a permanent Focus boost and free access to Shirley's car.

setup.name: Shirley's Part 2
setup.objective: Walk next door to accept the job, steal neighbor Peggy's mobility scooter and deliver it to Shirley.

setup.name: Northern Key Lento Sweep
setup.objective: Swing by The Rusty Anchor at the north end of Key Lento and slip into the garage next door to trigger the Evidence of a Murder Easter egg and loot the "Vice City Man's Collection" Card from the back chest.
setup.intel: Then slip into the living room of the nearby house to snag the "Lupin Juarez" Standard Card.

notes: Reward: permanent Focus boost and free access to Shirley's car.

CAT-026.title: Catch A Bigger Fish

overview.objective: Accept Cal's fishing hangout invitation before dusk.

CAT-026.intel: Unlocks an early fishing perk and a chance to unwind after two heavy days. The Southern Key Lento sweep wraps up the day.

setup.name: Cal's Fishing Contest
setup.objective: Accept Cal's optional fishing hangout invitation before dusk.

setup.name: Southern Key Lento Sweep
setup.objective: Before heading back to Peach Palm Dr., slip into the enterable house on the south end of Key Lento and claim the Gun Nut SMS-01 Sniper Rifle for your safehouse locker.
setup.intel: Wind down with a balcony cigar and sleep until Day 4.

notes: Reward: Gun Nut SMS-01 Sniper Rifle from the southern Key Lento house.
